title: feat(list): view tabs share the list toolbar row — ListView toolbarLeading host prop (objectui#12440)
body:
Fixes #12440
Clause-②: yes

The console list page draws the saved-view tabs and the list toolbar's Filter · Sort · Display · Search on one bordered row from `sm` up. `ListView` gets a leading toolbar slot as a React host prop, and the console hands its `ViewTabBar` into it instead of drawing a tab row of its own above the list.

## What changed

**`@object-ui/plugin-list` — `ListView`**
- New host prop `toolbarLeading?: React.ReactNode`. It renders first in the toolbar row's left group, before `user-filters`, inside a `min-w-0 flex-1` wrapper (`data-testid="list-toolbar-leading"`). When it is present the left group also gets `flex-1`, so the wrapper really has the width the right-hand tool cluster leaves. The width-fitted strip from objectui#12423 needs that: in a content-sized group its zero-basis strip would measure 0 and fold every tab.
- Absent (or `null`/`false`): no wrapper, and the left group's class string is exactly today's.
- The prop is destructured by name, so it does not ride the `{...props}` forward into the active view component.
- It is not a schema key. The list view's own `tabs` key stays retired (objectui#11073).
- README: a short "Host slot: `toolbarLeading`" section.

**`@object-ui/app-shell` — console `ObjectView`**
- The `hidden sm:block border-b …` row that wrapped `ViewTabBar` is gone. The page builds the same `ViewTabBar` element (same items, callbacks, "+" add-view and admin menus) and passes it to `ListView` as `toolbarLeading` from `renderListView`.
- From `sm` up only. A small `useViewTabsFit` hook (matchMedia on 640 px, first read synchronous so the row does not draw once without the strip and then jump) decides whether the element is built at all. Below `sm` nothing is passed and nothing is drawn. The CSS `hidden` it replaces only hid the strip. The app bar's mobile view switcher is unchanged.
- `ManageViewsDialog` used to be mounted inside the removed row. It is now mounted on its own at page level, under the same condition (admin, at least one view).

**Changeset:** `.changeset/12440-list-toolbar-leading-slot.md`, `minor` for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/app-shell`.

## Decisions and deviations (please read)

- **A refused view keeps a standalone tab row.** When the server refuses the open view (objectui#12112), the page draws the refusal face instead of the list, so there is no toolbar to carry the strip. The tabs are the way off that view, so in that one state they keep a row of their own (`data-testid="view-tab-row"`, same classes as before minus `hidden sm:block`). Everywhere a list is drawn there is no standalone row. Pinned by the existing `ObjectView.viewRefusal-12112` tests, which still find the strip with an empty active view.
- **There was only one `ViewTabBar` mount.** The card and the dispatch named a second mount, about 25 lines below the first. On `origin/main` (base `27411ead4`) and on `a2225f9` there is one `ViewTabBar` element. The second element in that row is `ManageViewsDialog`, which is a dialog and does not draw a strip. It moved to page level, as above.
- **"Unsaved changes" is not wired in the console.** The card says the strip carries an "Unsaved changes" affordance. `ViewTabBar` has one (`hasUnsavedChanges` / `showSaveAsView`), but the console passes neither prop, so it never drew there before this change and does not now. The changeset does not claim it. Nothing about it changed.
- **While a by-name view is being checked, no strip is drawn.** `viewAccess.checking` renders no list, so the strip is absent for that short window. Before this change it drew on its own row during the check.
- **Split navigation.** With a record open in split mode the list sits in the left pane, so the strip now sits in that pane's toolbar and folds to that pane's width. Before, it spanned the page above both panes.
- **Visual offset to check in the browser.** `ViewTabBar`'s root keeps its `-mb-px`, which was made for a row whose bottom border the tab underline overlaps. Inside the toolbar row's `py-1.5` the active tab's underline sits about 6 px above the row's border. This is cosmetic, and the seat's browser pass at 1440 should judge it. No change was made to `ViewTabBar` (not in the file surface).
- **Three test harnesses changed.** Three existing app-shell tests stub `ListView` and found the strip on the old standalone row (`ObjectView.viewRefusal-12112`, `ObjectView.servedViewLabel-11295`, `ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583`). Their `ListView` stand-ins now draw the `toolbarLeading` node they are handed, and the refusal test's plugin-view stand-in calls `renderListView` as the real one does. No assertion was changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **A4, the layout measurement (first data row at 1440 ≤ 200 px): NOT MEASURED here.** No backend or console was run in this session. The browser acceptance at 1440 / 1024 / 390 against the design reference on the card is the seat's and the maintainer's.
- The user-filters block's comment in `ListView` still says the chips are "mutually exclusive with view tabs above". That is about the retired node-level tabs and is left as is.
- Serial: objectui#12418 (per-user list state) is still in flight on `ObjectView.tsx` / `ListView.tsx`. This branch touched only the `ViewTabBar` mount, `renderListView`'s `ListView` element and dependency list, and the toolbar row's left group. `origin/main` is merged in twice (merge commits, no rebase), the second time right before opening this PR. It brought in objectui#12427's PR #12443, and neither merge touched the edited regions.

## Verification

Every test run is from the worktree root through the shared verify lock.

- **Placement pins (new):**
  - `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.toolbarLeading-12440.test.tsx` (4 tests): node first in the left group, before `user-filters`, in a `min-w-0 flex-1` wrapper inside the bordered toolbar row; without the prop and with `null` the left group is today's class string; not forwarded to the view component.
  - `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.viewTabsInToolbar-12440.test.tsx` (3 tests, real `ObjectView` → plugin `ObjectView` → `ListView` → `ViewTabBar`): at 1440 no standalone row and `view-tab-bar` inside the list toolbar slot, on the same row as `toolbar-filter-trigger`; with the strip laid out at 320 px the "N more" `view-tab-overflow` appears inside the slot and fewer than 8 tabs show; at 390 no `view-tab-bar` and no slot.
- **Ablation** (committed tree `8181905f9`; `ablation-replace.mjs`, `{toolbarLeading}` → `{null}` in `ListView.tsx`, anchor 1 → 0, blob `beb512a41006` → `b69871ab3ab8`): 4 tests red (the plugin-list placement pin, its not-forwarded pin, and both desktop ObjectView pins), 3 green (both absent pins and the phone pin, which do not depend on the render). Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The red direction is the expected one.
- **Targeted at the final head `39d14e00c`:** the two new files, `ObjectView.viewRefusal-12112`, `ObjectView.servedViewLabel-11295`, `ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583`, `ObjectView.favoritesEntry-12427` and `ViewTabBar.widthFit-12423`: `Test Files 7 passed (7)`, `Tests 54 passed (54)`.
- **Broad run at `6be3e3b8c`** (after the first merge): `packages/plugin-list/`, `packages/app-shell/src/views/` and the `ViewTabBar` tests gave `Test Files 2 failed | 1065 passed (1067)`, `Tests 25 failed | 10659 passed | 1 skipped`. The two failing files were `ObjectView.servedViewLabel-11295` and `ObjectView.viewWriteRefusal-11583`: their `ListView` stand-ins did not draw the strip. `374613b00` updates their harnesses, and they pass (above). The second merge touched none of the edited files. The broad run was not repeated at `39d14e00c`: the lock queue ran past 40 minutes this session. That is left to CI.
- **Type-check:** closure built (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 28/28). `@object-ui/plugin-list` `type-check` exit 0 and `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` exit 0 at `6be3e3b8c`. `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` was run again at `374613b00`, exit 0. Both `type-check` scripts also run `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes the test files. The built `dist/ListView.d.ts` carries `toolbarLeading`.
- **Lint, narrowed:** `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 7 changed source and test files gave 0 errors. Warnings per file equal the base `27411ead4` counts, file by file (ObjectView 176 = 176, ListView 196 = 196, the edited tests unchanged, the new tests 0). The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Pre-tsc battery, all exit 0:** `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `new-line-citations` (0 new). Also exit 0: `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- **`check:spec-floors`** exits 1, as it does on `main` (objectui#12334). Recorded, not changed.
- **NOT MEASURED, declared to CI:** `apps/console` tests, the app-shell suites outside `src/views/`, and the browser pass.
